typical_rate: 2.5 to 3 g per litre of water (about 10 L of spray per tree)
notes: Protective: start at green-tip and repeat every 10-14 days in wet spring weather; reapply after heavy rain. Also covers premature leaf fall and Alternaria spot. Waiting period before harvest: 40 days. Registered for apple (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 0.75 g per litre of water (0.075%)
notes: Has some curative action if sprayed within a day or two of a wet spell. Different group from the triazoles, so good for rotation. Waiting period before harvest: 21 days. Registered for apple (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 0.5 ml per litre of water (50 ml per 100 L)
notes: Absorbed into the leaf; can stop infections that started 2-3 days earlier. Don't use group 3 products back to back. Waiting period before harvest: 30 days. Registered for apple (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 0.4 ml per litre of water (1 L in 2,500 L per hectare)
notes: Also covers powdery mildew. Waiting period before harvest: 33 days. Registered for apple (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 2 g per litre of water (1.5 to 2 kg in 750 to 1,000 L per hectare)
notes: Protective spray; pair with pruning out cankers and removing mummified fruit, which matters more. Also registered for scab. Registered for apple (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 1.5 to 2 g per litre of water (1.125 to 1.5 kg in 750 L per hectare)
notes: Spray when the first lesions appear on lower leaves; repeat after 10 days if wet weather continues. Registered for maize (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 1 ml per litre of water (500 ml in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Also covers common rust. Waiting period before harvest: 25 days. Registered for maize (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 2 ml per litre of water (1 L in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Also covers rust and downy mildew. Long waiting period before harvest (52 days), so use it early. Registered for maize (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 1 ml per litre of water (500 ml in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Spray when pustules first appear on the leaves. Waiting period before harvest: 25 days. Registered for maize (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 2 ml per litre of water (1 L in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Long waiting period before harvest (52 days), so use it early. Registered for maize (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 3 L in 500 L of water per hectare (check the label for the exact rate)
notes: Registered for grape leaf spot as well as downy and powdery mildew. Waiting period before harvest: 5 days. Registered for grape (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: about 3 ml per litre of water (2.25 to 3 L in 750 to 1,000 L per hectare)
notes: Low-cost. Don't spray sulphur when it is hotter than about 30 °C, as it can scorch cucurbit leaves. Registered for cucurbits (CIB&RC, Mar 2024); check the label lists squash.

typical_rate: 1 ml per litre of water (500 ml in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Also covers downy mildew. Don't use group 11 more than twice in a row. Waiting period before harvest: 5 days. Registered for cucurbits (CIB&RC, Mar 2024); check the label lists squash.

typical_rate: about 0.2 to 0.25 ml per litre of water (100 to 125 ml in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Waiting period before harvest: 10 days. Registered for cucurbits (CIB&RC, Mar 2024); check the label lists squash.

typical_rate: 3 g per litre of water (3 kg in 1,000 L per hectare)
notes: Use once symptoms appear; best when infection began in the last 1-2 days. Add a sticker at 0.1%. Waiting period before harvest: 10 days. Recommended in the ICAR-CPRI late blight advisory. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 1 g dimethomorph + 2 g mancozeb per litre of water (1 kg + 2 kg in 1,000 L per hectare)
notes: Use once symptoms appear. Alternate with a product from a different group. Waiting period before harvest (dimethomorph): 16 days. Recommended in the ICAR-CPRI late blight advisory. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 3 g per litre of water (3 kg in 1,000 L per hectare)
notes: Use once symptoms appear. Alternate with a product from a different group. Waiting period before harvest: 30 days. Recommended in the ICAR-CPRI late blight advisory. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 2.5 g per litre of water (2.5 kg in 1,000 L per hectare)
notes: Fast-acting on active blight. Metalaxyl resistance has been reported in late blight populations, so limit to 2-3 sprays a season and alternate with a product from a different group. Waiting period before harvest: 24 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 0.8 ml per litre of water
notes: Binds to the leaf wax, so holds up well in rain. Same group as dimethomorph, so don't alternate between those two. Waiting period before harvest: 40 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 0.4 ml per litre of water (200 ml in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Very strong but high resistance risk: use at most 2 times a season and alternate with a product from a different group. Waiting period before harvest: 22 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 3 to 3.5 g per litre of water (1.5 to 1.75 kg in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Same group (11) as fenamidone, so don't alternate between those two. Waiting period before harvest: 15 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 0.4 ml per litre of water (200 ml in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Preventive: works best before or at the very first symptoms. Waiting period before harvest: 27 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 2 g per litre of water (2 kg in 1,000 L per hectare)
notes: For prevention before any symptoms, when the forecast is cool and humid. Weak once blight is active. Reapply after heavy rain. Recommended in the ICAR-CPRI late blight advisory. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: about 1.5 g per litre of water (0.875 to 1.25 kg in 600 to 800 L per hectare)
notes: Preventive only. Useful as a protectant partner to rotate with the systemic products. Waiting period before harvest: 14 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 3 g per litre of water (1.5 kg in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Low-cost preventive option, also accepted in many organic programmes. Weak on active blight. Waiting period before harvest: 22 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 3 g per litre of water (1.5 kg in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Moves into the leaf and also protects the surface. Don't use group 11 products more than twice in a row. Waiting period before harvest: 25 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 1 ml per litre of water (500 ml in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Same group (11) as azoxystrobin, so rotate with hexaconazole or a protectant instead. Waiting period before harvest: 25 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 6 ml per litre of water (3 L in 500 L per hectare)
notes: Different group from the strobilurins, so good for rotation. Waiting period before harvest: 21 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: 2 to 2.5 g per litre of water (1.5 to 2 kg in 750 L per hectare)
notes: Low-cost protective spray. Start when the first spots appear on lower leaves and reapply after heavy rain. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: about 1.5 g per litre of water (0.875 to 1.25 kg in 600 to 800 L per hectare)
notes: Good protectant to rotate with the systemic products. Waiting period before harvest: 14 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).

typical_rate: about 1.7 g per litre of water (1.667 kg in 1,000 L per hectare)
notes: Low-cost protectant from a different group. Short waiting period before harvest: 8 days. Registered for potato (CIB&RC major uses list, Mar 2024).
